Summary of the video:
1. Temp market drops should not trigger exit
2. Invest in SIP only when you can keep the investment intact for a long term - like 15-20 yrs
3. Invest extra when NIFTY drops (may be by  10%)
4. Invest lump-sum strategically - by looking at performance in last 1-2 yrs. If the fund has already given a rally then it will correct itself - so not a good point to invest.
